messages:
maya: Quick sync — post-deploy follow-up. Need to decide what goes into the next 2-week minor iteration. TL;DR: P0 bugs first, then customer-facing P1s, then small UX fixes that unblock onboarding/retention. Thoughts?

jon: +1. Suggest we be explicit: P0 = site-down/major regressions; P1 = >=3 customers impacted OR >2% error rate OR clear revenue/regulatory impact. Anything that matches -> slot it into sprint.

ara: Agree on criteria. One datapoint: onboarding funnel drop after the new flow — 8 distinct reports in the past 7 days and a 4% dip in step completion. That feels like a high-priority enhancement even if it's not a classic "bug".

rob: Technical caveat: the onboarding fix likely needs a DB schema migration that will prevent a true canary -> risk = medium. Quick mitigations: either do a small revert of the flow (low-effort) or schedule the migration with a maintenance window. Revert cost ~1d, migration ~3d + QA.

callie: From CS: three enterprise prospects paused final sign-off because of routing/SLAs for dedicated capacity. That's blocking deals — can we treat that as a P1 enhancement for this sprint?

maya: Proposed prioritization matrix for this sprint:
- P0 (regressions/outages) -> immediate hotfix, priority pipeline
- P1 with >=3 customers OR clear revenue impact -> target this sprint
- P1 UX with funnel/regression but requiring big migration -> prefer revert / bandaid this sprint, full migration next
- Non-critical enhancements -> polish bucket next minor

jon: Also, let's gate any non-essential enhancements behind a 'stability freeze' during the minor to keep risk low. Keep a tiny polish backlog for low-effort wins.

rob: Adding rough dev estimates to help decisions: onboarding migration = 3d dev + 1d QA, revert = 1d total; SLA routing for dedicated = 2d infra + config + testing. I'll put these into the ticket comments.

maya: Can everybody add labels in Jira so triage is clearer? Use labels: triage:postdeploy, prio:P0 / prio:P1, effort:quick/med/large. Example command we use in the CLI: `jira create "Onboarding: regressions" --labels triage:postdeploy,prio:P1,effort:med`. Also scheduling a 30m huddle tomorrow 10:30 PT to finalize scope — @jon @ara @rob @callie please RSVP.

callie: RSVP yes. Also request we send a short customer-facing note if we revert onboarding, call it out as temporary rollback for reliability.

ara: +1 on customer note, I'll draft a short checkbox copy and loop in comms.

rob: Quick rollback command for ops reference: `git revert -m 1 abcd1234 && ./deploy.sh --canary` — I'll test in staging now. :wrench:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: onboarding-flow-revert -> 2024-11-04T18:00:00Z. Status: queued. :truck:

maya: Thanks team. Agreed actions: 1) label and estimate tickets today, 2) huddle tomorrow 10:30 PT to finalize sprint board, 3) eng will prepare revert as low-risk option, 4) CS will draft customer note. Also propose freeze on new feature merges to main until after the minor. :lock:

jon: +1 to freeze from eng side. We'll block merges via branch protection.

rob: I'll add the branch-protection rule and a quick CI check to prevent accidental merges.

maya: Great — I'll follow up with the meeting invite and the grooming doc link when it's live. Thanks all. :handshake:
